summary_en: 574,200 shares (5.0% of shares outstanding) acquired for ¥571.9M via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-13. Acquisition program authorized 2026-08-12 now complete. Rationale: employee and officer incentive plan expansion and improved stock liquidity.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition Results and Completion of Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Self-Trading (ToSTNeT-3) and Change in Major Shareholders
translation_en_brief: MEEQ Inc. (332A, TSE Growth) completed acquisition of 574,200 treasury shares for ¥571.9M on 2026-08-13 via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange trading). The acquisition was authorised by board resolution on 2026-08-12 and represents 5.0% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The stated rationale is to support expansion of employee and officer incentive plans and to improve stock liquidity. The acquisition resulted in a change in major shareholders: Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corp. held 1,277,300 shares (11.13% voting share, 2nd position) as of 2026-03-31 and now holds 703,100 shares (6.45%, 3rd position) post-acquisition. The company states this shareholder change has no material effect on business performance.
